text:
jon: 👍 kicked off a tiny thread about the Rerank Playground tweaks I prototyped this morning. main asks: keyboard flow through the preview table and what we should include in the export metadata (csv vs jsonl).
lia: quick q — is the preview table intended for live rerank feedback (low latency) or for offline batch inspection? affects how we annotate rows for screen readers.
maria: live feedback. we want the preview to reflect exact reranker score + original rank + vector id. screen readers should be able to announce score changes when you apply a filter.
sam: regarding keyboard — current tab order goes: row checkbox -> score -> actions. feels weird when score is non-interactive. suggestion: make score focusable (button with aria-pressed?) so announcer can read it and user can open the score history.
ben: +1 to making score focusable. but if it's a button we need clear affordance — maybe small icon with tooltip instead of entire score as button. also we need an aria-live region for changes from the server (score updates).
lia: for export — customers asked for provenance: prompt hash, model id/version, rerank seed, and sample size. CSV doesn't handle nested provenance well. jsonl would be more explicit.
jon: what about offering both? default CSV for quick download, then a "Download with provenance (JSONL)" option. small CTA under export menu.
maria: copy nits: instead of "Download provenance", say "Export results with run details" — clearer. also need SR (screen reader) copy for that menu item.
sam: accessibility nit — when user opens the row context menu via keyboard (kebab), focus should remain in the row and the menu should trap focus until closed. currently focus jumps back to table header.
design-bot: reminder: accessibility checklist v2 applied to /rerank-playground UI — see /docs/accessibility/rerank-playground.md :link:
ben: table column sorting — we surface reranker score, embed distance, and original rank. Screen reader should announce sort direction. use aria-sort on th and visible sort indicator.
lia: thought: add a compact mode for dense preview lists (6–8 rows) to reduce visual noise. but ensure row density change doesn't break keyboard hit targets (>=44px).
jon: UX trade: denser rows good for batch triage, but we must keep touch targets for mobile. proposal: compact only for desktop widths > 900px.
maria: export header example (CSV):
```
vector_id,original_rank,rerank_score,model_id,run_id,query_hash
```
add a companion JSONL example for provenance: each line is a JSON object with the same fields + full prompt and timestamp.
sam: minor copy: in preview header change "Rerank results" -> "Rerank preview" to avoid implying finality.
ben: QA note — if we add score focusable control and aria-live updates, we should throttle announcements to avoid screen reader spam. coalesce updates within 2s window.
lia: edgecase: when applying batch filters, table should announce "filter applied: removing duplicates" and number of visible rows. use polite aria-live.
jon: can someone mock the compact mode + focusable score? lia can you do quick figma frames and i'll hook up a prototype.
lia: on it. will post frames by EOD. :eyes:
maria: I'll draft the export copy and JSONL schema. want to align on field names before dev.
sam: dev notes: backend will include run_id and model_version. I'll add an endpoint flag to include full prompt when requested (opt-in for privacy).
jon: sweet. thanks all. followups: lia design frames, maria export schema, sam dev flag. leaving thread here. :thumbsup:
